POP Series 6

Released September 1, 2007 · 17 cards

POP Series 6 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on September 1, 2007. It has 17 cards. It includes 17 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
